verdict.rationale: Poly is an AI file-storage and knowledge-base product, so native mobile apps are a fair question for it. The evidence only describes web, desktop (Finder/Explorer sync), CLI and MCP surfaces, with no mention of iOS or Android apps. The product page itself says it is 'available on web and desktop', so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, full-featured iOS and Android apps give me my whole knowledge base — capture, search, and linking — not a stripped-down companion
